defs.def: to come or go back from one place to another 回来；回去；返回

ex.s: A family member is returning from a year-long trip, and you are meeting her at the airport.
ex.t: 一位家庭成员结束为期一年的旅行归来，你要去机场接她。

ex.s: Robert then decided to return to the fight, winning independence for the Scots — on the seventh attempt.
ex.t: 罗伯特随后决定重返战斗，在第七次尝试中为苏格兰人赢得了独立。

ex.s: Most of Ho’s students will recover, which means that preparing them to return to school is an increasingly important component of care.
ex.t: 何的学生大多会康复，这意味着让他们准备重返学校正日益成为护理的一个重要组成部分。

ex.s: A 35-minute hand-clapping, foot-stomping musical version of a Mark Twain favorite returns with this Tall Stacks festival.
ex.t: 这部时长35分钟、伴随着拍手跺脚的音乐剧改编自马克·吐温的经典作品，将在Tall Stacks节上回归。

ex.s: When I returned to London in 2004, I found myself wandering down to Southbank, spending hours there.
ex.t: 2004年回到伦敦时，我发现自己在南岸闲逛，在那里度过几个小时。

ex.s: A few years later, still attracted to the country, he returned to Uzbekistan to write an article about the disappearance of the Aral Sea.
ex.t: 几年后仍然被这个国家吸引他回到乌兹别克斯坦写一篇关于咸海消失的文章。

ex.s: What made Mr Bissell return to Uzbekistan? （    ）
ex.t: 是什么让比塞尔回到乌兹别克斯坦？（    ）

ex.s: Returning to a book you’ve read many times can feel like drinks with an old friend.
ex.t: 重读一本你读过很多遍的书，感觉就像与老朋友喝一杯。

ex.s: Some people live with their elderly parents; many more adult children are returning to the family home, if they ever left.
ex.t: 有些人和年迈的父母住在一起；更多的成年子女回到家中（如果他们曾经离开的话）。

ex.s: After we returned to the hotel late in the afternoon, my 7-year-old son Ponder   13   that nowhere could he find his backpack, which   14   his Gameboy and his watch.
ex.t: 下午晚些时候我们回到酒店后，我7岁的儿子Ponder____13____发现他到处都找不到他的背包，里面____14____他的Gameboy和手表。

ex.s: Who is eligible: Students aged 15-29, returning to school in the fall.
ex.t: 谁有资格：15至29岁的学生，秋季返校就读。

ex.s: “It's a chance for self-reflection, You return to work recharged and with a plan.”
ex.t: "这是一个自我反省的机会，你回到工作岗位时充满活力并且有了计划。"

ex.s: 8．（1分）Amy， as well as her brothers，________a warm welcome when returning to the village last week．（  ）
ex.t: 8．（1分）艾米和她兄弟们上周回到村庄时受到了热烈的欢迎。（  ）

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 在发现一辆____18____宠物狗坐在停着的车的前座上、车窗摇下后，他在雨中守候了约两小时等待____19____主人回来。

ex.s: In 1747，when Benjamin  was nine years old，MrPennington returned for another visit .He was amazed at what Benjamin had done with his gift.He asked  Benjamin’s parents if he might take the boy to Philadelphia for a visit.
ex.t: 1747年，当本杰明九岁的时候，彭宁顿先生再次来访。他对本杰明用礼物所做的创作感到惊讶。他问本杰明的父母是否可以带男孩去费城参观。

ex.s: Ehlers returned to Minnesotan, and then drove 100 miles to Minneapolis to put Rosie on a flight to Michigan.
ex.t: 埃勒斯回到了明尼苏达州，然后开车100英里到明尼阿波利斯让罗西搭乘飞往密歇根州的航班。

ex.s: Maurice Ashley was kind and smart, a former graduate returning to teach, and this  48  was no game for him: he meant business.
ex.t: 莫里斯·阿什利既善良又聪明，是一位回校任教的往届毕业生，对他来说这____48____不是游戏：他是认真的。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次活动结束后，我回到家感觉更坚强、更轻松，更有能力继续前行。

ex.s: Why did the author like to spend time in Southbank when he returned to London?
ex.t: 为什么作者回到伦敦后喜欢在南岸消磨时光？

ex.s: She returns to work feeling energized.
ex.t: 她回到工作岗位时感到精力充沛。

ex.s: Three days later, Emily returned to get her car.
ex.t: 三天后，Emily回来取车。

ex.s: We bravely drove off again two hours later after we’d returned home to get the purse and traveler’s checks Mom had forgotten.
ex.t: 两小时后，在我们回家取妈妈忘记的钱包和旅行支票后，我们勇敢地再次开车出发。

ex.s: At the end of our trip, I told my father that I planned to return for every two years, but he agreed.
ex.t: 在我们旅行结束时，我告诉父亲我计划每两年回来一次，但他同意了。

ex.s: Forms will be available in school and online for them to indicate their choices and return to school.
ex.t: 表格将在学校和网上提供，供他们标明选择并回到学校。

ex.s: When the car’s owner John Anderson and his colleague Carol Lawrence returned to the car—which was itself worth £35, 000—in Glasgow city centre, they were    23    to find two policemen standing next to it.
ex.t: 当车主John Anderson和他的同事Carol Lawrence回到那辆本身价值35,000英镑、停在格拉斯哥市中心的车时，他们____23____发现两名警察站在车旁。

ex.s: When Wilson returned home from hospital two months later, his parents ____44____ to find a way to deal with the catastrophe that had ______45______ their lives.
ex.t: 当Wilson两个月后从医院回家时，他的父母____44____试图找到一种方法来应对这场已经____45____改变了他们生活的灾难。

ex.s: He returned to Britain in 1931, where he worked in business.
ex.t: 他于1931年回到英国，在那里从事商业工作。

ex.s: He established an office to keep records of the children, and then returned to Britain to find temporary homes for them.
ex.t: 他建立了一个办公室来记录孩子们的信息，然后返回英国为他们寻找临时住所。

ex.s: Yet, despite all this, by the end of the trip many were already planning to return.
ex.t: 然而，尽管如此，到旅行结束时，许多人已经在计划返回了。

defs.def: to bring, give, put or send sth back to sb/sth 带回；送回；放回；退还

ex.s: Return it when it is recalled.
ex.t: 召回时请将其退回。

ex.s: “I really want to make this work for ___64___ (people) lives today, and I know that doesn’t always mean   ___65___ (return) a dress on the Monday after a special weekend,” she says.
ex.t: “我真的想让这适用于今天____64____（people 人们）的生活，而且我知道这并不总是意味着在特殊周末后的周一____65____（return 退回）一件裙子，”她说。

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

ex.s: Books must be returned within a month.
ex.t: 书籍必须在一个月内归还。

ex.s: Eventually, the man ____13____ (catch) up with her, and he was only trying to return her wallet!
ex.t: 最终，那个男人____13____ (catch)追上了她，他只是想把钱包还给她！

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合放归保护区的野外区域还为时过早。

ex.s: Zac recently returned another lost medal to a family in Alabama.
ex.t: 扎克最近将另一枚丢失的勋章归还给了阿拉巴马州的一个家庭。

ex.s: Almost all of the lost items were returned to their owners.
ex.t: 几乎所有丢失的物品都归还给了它们的主人。

ex.s: Usually the offender would appear at the end of the day, and I would return the belonging.
ex.t: 通常冒犯者会在一天结束时出现，而我会归还物品。

ex.s: Please complete the questionnaire and return it to me.
ex.t: 请完成问卷并交还给我。

defs.def: to come back again 恢复；重现

ex.s: As autumn comes, she gets restless—the same old wanderlust returning.
ex.t: 随着秋天到来，她变得不安分——同样的旧日漫游癖再次浮现。

ex.s: Natural dyes are now returning to popularity, especially with artists and craftspeople.
ex.t: 天然染料如今重新流行起来，尤其受到艺术家和手工艺人的喜爱。

defs.def: to start discussing a subject you were discussing earlier, or doing an activity you were doing earlier 重提；重新开始做
to go back to a previous state 恢复；回复

ex.s: Luck stayed with them; Paris’ heartbeat returned.
ex.t: 好运与他们同在；巴黎的心跳恢复了。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED获得了热情的评价，但它从一开始就被设计成一个短命的实验；自那以后Blue Hill已恢复了常规菜单。

defs.def: to do or give sth to sb because they have done or given the same to you first; to have the same feeling about sb that they have about you 回报；回应
to hit the ball back to your opponent during a game 回击；击回
to give a decision about sth in court 宣告（裁决）
to elect sb to a political position 选举；选出；推举
to give or produce a particular amount of money as a profit or loss 带来，产生（利润或损失）
the action of arriving in or coming back to a place that you were in before 回来；归来；返回

ex.s: The book ends with Rosamond and Dorothy’s return to Auburn.
ex.t: 这本书以罗萨蒙德和多萝西返回奥本镇作结。

ex.s: For Pahlsson, its return was   65   wonder.
ex.t: 对于帕尔森来说，它的失而复返简直是____奇迹。

defs.def: the action of giving, putting or sending sth/sb back 归还；放回；退回
the situation when a feeling or state that has not been experienced for some time starts again 重现；恢复
the action of going back to an activity or a situation that you used to do or be in 恢复；返回
the amount of profit that you get from sth 回报；收益；利润
an official report or statement that gives particular information to the government or another body 报告；陈述；申报
“我要一张到布莱顿的票。” “单程的还是往返的？”
a ticket for the theatre or a sports game that was bought by sb but is given back to be sold again 退票
the button that you press on a computer when you reach the end of an instruction, or to begin a new line 返回键；回车键；结束键
the action of hitting the ball, etc. back to your opponent 网球和其他一些运动
as a way of thanking sb or paying them for sth they have done 作为（对 … 的）回报

ex.s: in addition toB. in return for
ex.t: 除……之外 B. 作为……的回报

ex.s: in pursuit of B. in return for
ex.t: 追求B. 作为回报

ex.s: Axani wrote in his post that he is not  55  anything in return and that the woman who uses the  56  ticket can choose to either travel with him or 57  the ticket and travel on her own.
ex.t: 阿克萨尼在帖子中写道，他不____任何回报，使用这张____票的女性可以选择与他一起旅行或者____这张票独自旅行。

defs.def: as a response or reaction to sth 作为回应
